name: test_invalid_credentials_are_rejected_with_401
description:
A correct auth endpoint signals failure via status code - a
client that only checks `response.ok` should not be able to
mistake a rejected login for a successful one.
descriptionHtml:
A correct auth endpoint signals failure via status code - a
client that only checks response.ok should not be able to
mistake a rejected login for a successful one.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: BUG-006: POST /auth returns 200 OK with a {'reason': 'Bad credentials'} body for invalid credentials instead of 401 Unauthorized (got 200)
assert 200 == 401
 +  where 200 = <Response [200]>.status_code
statusTrace:
self = <tests.test_auth.TestAuth object at 0x7f27a1ed8b90>
api_client = <api.client.BookingApiClient object at 0x7f27a1d60050>

    @allure.severity(allure.severity_level.NORMAL)
    @pytest.mark.negative
    def test_invalid_credentials_are_rejected_with_401(self, api_client):
        """A correct auth endpoint signals failure via status code - a
        client that only checks `response.ok` should not be able to
        mistake a rejected login for a successful one.
        """
        response = api_client.auth(AUTH_USERNAME, "definitely-wrong-password")
